turns.text:
quick q. make my reply less rude pls. carla texted me this:

"scanners keep dying on the outbound floor, like 6 more just went red. pickers are way behind rate. need replacements NOW"

and i was gonna send:

"yeah i know. it's another red-beep night. it's pouring and everything is wet. i can't swap them faster than i already am. i have one pair of hands. you'll get them when you get them"

ugh been on tickets for like 8 hrs. eating colima tacos in the cage while i type this lol

Happy to. I kept it honest and direct, just dropped the edge:

"Hi Carla, got it. Another red-beep night, and the rain isn't helping. I'm swapping the 6 units now and will send replacements to the floor in batches as each one is tested, so you'll have the first few in about [X] minutes. I'll text you when the last one is out."

Notes:
- Swap in your real ETA for [X]. If you're not sure, give a range.
- The "batches" line lets her know units are coming without you promising all six at once.
- If you want it even shorter: "On it. Another red-beep night. First replacements to the floor in about [X] min, I'll text when the rest are out."

Enjoy the tacos, and hang in there.
tldr the short one is good. can it say wet units take longer to test

Sure:

"On it. Another red-beep night, and wet units take longer to test. First replacements to the floor in about [X] min, I'll text when the rest are out."

Paste in your ETA and send it.
Glad it works. Good luck getting the floor back on rate.
